articles.title: Mother, Lover Accused in Death of 5-Year-Old Girl: Bengaluru Case Surfaces Three Months Later
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman and her alleged lover have been accused of murdering her five-year-old daughter in Bengaluru, with the case coming to light nearly three months after the child's death following a complaint filed by the girl's father. The victim, Vennila, reportedly died on March 24.

body.html:
A woman and her alleged lover have been accused of murdering her five-year-old daughter in Bengaluru, with the case coming to light nearly three months after the child's death following a complaint filed by the girl's father.

The victim, Vennila, reportedly died on March 24. Her father, Praveen, later approached the police, alleging that his wife, Priyanka, and her alleged lover, Mohan, were responsible for the child's death.

Praveen, a native of Davanagere, married Bengaluru resident Priyanka in 2007. The couple have two daughters aged 17 and 5.

According to police, Priyanka reconnected with her college friend Mohan a few years ago, and the two allegedly developed a close relationship before eventually living together. Following disputes over the relationship, Priyanka had reportedly been seeking a divorce.

Police said Priyanka was living with Mohan along with her younger daughter at the time of the incident.

Investigators found discrepancies in Priyanka's explanations regarding the child's sudden death. On one occasion, she allegedly told family members that she had fed the girl biryani. At another time, she reportedly claimed that she had given the child ice cream and left her sleeping inside an air-conditioned car.

She later stated that she returned home and found the girl dead the following morning.

Suspicion deepened when Praveen shared the post-mortem report with a relative who is a doctor working abroad. After reviewing the report, the relative reportedly raised concerns about possible foul play.

Based on those observations, Praveen filed a police complaint alleging that his daughter had been assaulted and suffocated to death.

Police have arrested Mohan in connection with the case, while Priyanka is currently absconding. Efforts are underway to trace and apprehend her.

Investigators said they are awaiting the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) report, which is expected to provide further clarity on the cause and circumstances of the child's death.

Further investigation is ongoing.

#Bengaluru #CrimeNews #ChildDeath #BreakingNews #KarnatakaNews

articles.title: Government Teacher Arrested Under POCSO in Seoni
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A government school teacher has been arrested under the POCSO Act after a Class 9 student alleged inappropriate behaviour by him at a school in Madhya Pradesh's Seoni district. The incident came to light on Thursday in the Bandol police station area.

body.html:
A government school teacher has been arrested under the POCSO Act after a Class 9 student alleged inappropriate behaviour by him at a school in Madhya Pradesh's Seoni district.

The incident came to light on Thursday in the Bandol police station area. The accused has been identified as Krishna Kumar Nayak.

According to police, the incident allegedly took place on May 29 when the student visited the school to collect her admit card for a supplementary examination. The school premises were reportedly not crowded at the time.

Police said the accused teacher allegedly behaved inappropriately with the minor student during her visit to the campus.

After returning home, the girl informed her family about the incident. Taking the matter seriously, her family approached Bandol police station and lodged a complaint.

Following the complaint, police launched an investigation and examined CCTV footage from cameras installed on the school premises. Officials said the footage was seized as important evidence in the case.

Based on the victim's statement and the available CCTV footage, police arrested the accused teacher on Thursday.

A case has been registered against him under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act and other relevant sections of law. Further legal proceedings are underway.

Bandol police station in-charge Manoj Janghela said the investigation is being conducted sensitively and that both the victim's statement and CCTV footage are key aspects of the probe.

The incident has triggered outrage among local residents and parents, who have demanded strict action against the accused and stronger measures to ensure the safety of girl students in schools.

The school management has not issued a detailed statement, saying it will comment only after the investigation is completed.

#Seoni #MadhyaPradesh #POCSO #SchoolSafety #BreakingNews

articles.title: Teen Opposed Mother's Affair, Was Killed and Stuffed Into Suitcase: Punjab Man Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 16-year-old girl was allegedly murdered by her mother's lover in Punjab's Nawanshahr district, after which her body was stuffed into a suitcase and partially burnt in a forest in an attempt to destroy evidence, police said.

body.html:
A 16-year-old girl was allegedly murdered by her mother's lover in Punjab's Nawanshahr district, after which her body was stuffed into a suitcase and partially burnt in a forest in an attempt to destroy evidence, police said.

The teenager had been reported missing, and her mother, Usha, had lodged a complaint with the police. She also submitted a CCTV clip that purportedly showed the girl leaving home.

However, during the investigation, police discovered that the footage was actually of another girl, raising suspicion. Officers then examined CCTV footage from nearby areas and allegedly spotted the accused, Gurvinder Singh (24), travelling on a motorcycle with a suitcase strapped to it.

Police said Singh had accompanied the victim's mother to the police station to file the missing person complaint.

Following the breakthrough, investigators detained and questioned Singh. During interrogation, he allegedly confessed to murdering the teenager at her residence and disposing of her body in a forest area in neighbouring Hoshiarpur district.

Police later recovered a partially burnt body from the forest, believed to be that of the missing girl.

According to investigators, the victim had objected to her mother's relationship with Singh. Police suspect that Singh held a grudge against the teenager over her opposition to the relationship.

Officials said the accused allegedly strangled the girl to death on May 29 while she was alone at home. He then allegedly packed the body into a suitcase, transported it on a motorcycle and attempted to burn it in the forest to conceal the crime.

Gurvinder Singh has been arrested and remanded to four days of police custody. Further investigation into the case is underway.

#PunjabCrime #Nawanshahr #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #MurderCase

articles.title: Highway Near-Miss in Tamil Nadu Caught on Camera
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tense moment unfolded on a highway in Tiruchengode, Namakkal, after a lorry transporting a JCB reportedly broke down in the right lane with its hazard lights and flashers activated.

body.html:
A tense moment unfolded on a highway in Tiruchengode, Namakkal, after a lorry transporting a JCB reportedly broke down in the right lane with its hazard lights and flashers activated.

Despite the warning signals, an approaching lorry allegedly spotted the stationary vehicle only at the last moment. A car travelling closely behind had its view obstructed due to tailgating, creating a dangerous situation that could have resulted in a major collision.

The incident serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a safe following distance and staying alert, especially on highways where visibility can change in seconds.

#Namakkal #Tiruchengode #RoadSafety #Highway #TamilNadu

articles.title: Traffic Cop Slaps Commuter During Drunk Driving Test in Gachibowli
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A traffic police official allegedly slapped a commuter during a drunk driving test in Hyderabad's Gachibowli area under the Cyberabad Police Commissionerate, with a video of the incident going viral on social media.

body.html:
A traffic police official allegedly slapped a commuter during a drunk driving test in Hyderabad's Gachibowli area under the Cyberabad Police Commissionerate, with a video of the incident going viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place on Saturday, June 6, during a routine breathalyser check.

According to the viral video, the commuter repeatedly held the breathalyser with his teeth instead of blowing into it. Two police officials can be seen instructing him on how to use the device.

"Just breathe into the machine, don't hold it," one officer is heard telling the commuter.

When the man again held the breathalyser with his teeth, another official asked him to repeat the test, saying, "You don't need to bite it, just breathe into it. Do you understand Telugu?"

However, after the commuter allegedly repeated the same mistake, the official slapped him across the face.

Moments later, another police constable approached the officers and can be heard saying, "Don't slap him, this is getting recorded."

The video has since gone viral on social media, sparking widespread reactions and debate over the conduct of the police personnel during the enforcement drive.

No official statement regarding the incident had been reported at the time of writing.

#Hyderabad #Gachibowli #CyberabadPolice #TrafficPolice #ViralVideo

articles.title: Teen's Skeletal Remains Found in Forest, Boyfriend Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 19-year-old woman, allegedly murdered by her boyfriend after she became pregnant, was found in a skeletal condition in a forest area on the outskirts of Lucknow on Saturday, police officials said.

body.html:
A 19-year-old woman, allegedly murdered by her boyfriend after she became pregnant, was found in a skeletal condition in a forest area on the outskirts of Lucknow on Saturday, police officials said.

The victim, a resident of Sandana in Sitapur district, had left her home on May 25 to attend college in Kuchlai village. When she failed to return, her family lodged a kidnapping case at Sandana police station.

During the investigation, police questioned Vishal Pal, a resident of Saraiya village in Sitapur district. Investigators said the two were in a relationship and that the woman had become pregnant. The accused allegedly killed her following a dispute over marriage and the pregnancy.

Based on information allegedly provided by Pal, police reached a forest area near the ring road and recovered clothes believed to belong to the victim, along with a slipper, skull-like skeletal remains, bones and hair.

Police said the victim's family identified the recovered clothing and remains. Officials added that the body had completely decomposed after being dumped in the forest and was found in a skeletal state.

A forensic team collected evidence from the spot, and the remains have been sent for post-mortem examination. Police said DNA profiling and other forensic tests will be conducted if required.

Sitapur Additional Superintendent of Police Durgesh Singh said the accused was arrested and allegedly confessed during interrogation.

He further stated that while police were taking the accused to recover evidence on Saturday, he asked to attend nature's call and allegedly attempted to escape by snatching a pistol and opening fire at the police team.

Police retaliated, and the accused sustained a bullet injury to his leg. He was shifted to a hospital for treatment.

Officials said further investigation is underway, and several key pieces of evidence have been recovered at the accused's instance.

#Lucknow #Sitapur #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #MurderCase

articles.title: Man Fires 10 Rounds at Mathura Akhada, Then Fights Police With Loaded Revolver
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic half-hour standoff unfolded on a busy road in Mathura after a man carrying a licensed revolver allegedly fired multiple rounds at a wrestling arena and later resisted police attempts to disarm him.

body.html:
A dramatic half-hour standoff unfolded on a busy road in Mathura after a man carrying a licensed revolver allegedly fired multiple rounds at a wrestling arena and later resisted police attempts to disarm him.

The incident took place around 9 pm on Friday (5 June 2026) in the Kotwali police station area. Police said the accused, Dinesh Vashishth (32), a resident of Sehi village under Shergarh police station limits, allegedly opened fire at Bhuteshwar Akhada before fleeing the scene.

According to eyewitnesses, Dinesh arrived at the akhada in a white Scorpio SUV and began firing immediately after stepping out of the vehicle. Panic spread through the area as wrestlers and local residents ran for safety. Fortunately, no one was injured.

Police said the firing stemmed from a personal dispute. Dinesh was allegedly in a relationship with a young woman, and Karan, a resident of Govindpur Gopalpura, had informed the woman's wrestler brother about the relationship, urging him to speak to his sister. After being reprimanded by her family, the woman allegedly informed Dinesh, who then abused Karan over the phone and threatened to kill him.

Police said Dinesh later reached Bhuteshwar Akhada and an argument broke out between the two men. During the confrontation, he allegedly fired around 10 to 11 rounds from his licensed revolver before fleeing.

Hearing the gunshots, local residents and wrestlers alerted the police. The accused abandoned his SUV and escaped on foot while still carrying the weapon, triggering panic as people hid from the armed man.

Police chased him for nearly one kilometre before intercepting him in Krishna Nagar, one of Mathura's busiest and most affluent areas.

The accused allegedly stood in the middle of the road holding the revolver and refused repeated police orders to surrender. When officers attempted to seize the weapon, he allegedly pushed and shoved them, issued threats and got into a scuffle with Krishna Nagar outpost in-charge Sanjeev Kumar and Sub-Inspector Mustaq Mohammad Mehndi.

Police repeatedly warned him to put the gun down, fearing it could accidentally discharge. After a prolonged struggle lasting nearly 30 minutes, officers overpowered him, dragged him to the roadside and seized the revolver.

A large crowd gathered during the standoff, leading to heavy traffic congestion on both sides of the road.

Police recovered six empty cartridge cases and are examining CCTV footage and other video recordings as part of the investigation. The accused remains in custody and is being questioned.

#Mathura #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh #Gunfire #PoliceAction

articles.title: Teen Girl Kidnapped at 11, Forcibly Married & Abused for 6 Years in Sambhal, Delivers Child
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sambhal police safely recovered a teenage girl, now 17, and her four-year-old child, who was kidnapped six years ago from Mahua Hasanganj village.

body.html:
Sambhal police safely recovered a teenage girl, now 17, and her four-year-old child, who was kidnapped six years ago from Mahua Hasanganj village. The girl was lured by a neighbour woman, her aunt, on pretext of work on March 17, 2020, and handed over to Akash alias Vetrapal of Duptakhurd village under Rajpura police station, Gunnaur tehsil.

The victim stated Akash forcibly married her, physically exploited her, and his sister Pooja alias Kasturi fully supported the crime. Police acted on a tip-off on May 1 when they spotted the woman and child in Singhauli Kallu village; Akash fled but was later arrested.

On June 6, 2026, Akash alias Vetrapal (26), son of Ghanshyam, and Pooja alias Kasturi (35), daughter of Ghanshyam, both residents of Duptakhurd, were arrested near Keshopur village on the road to Haribaba Dam. Both have been sent to jail.

Victim and child are at One Stop Center, Bahjoi, under protection and reunited with family. Case FIR No. 138/2020 under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376D, 370, 120B IPC and 5J(2)/6 POCSO Act at Rajpura police station. Investigation by SI Baburam Saini, AHTU, under SP Krishna Kumar Bishnoi and ASP Manoj Kumar Rawat.

#SambhalKidnap #ChildAbuse #POCSO #ForcedMarriage #SambhalHorror

articles.title: Lift Door Opens, Woman Plunges to Death: 13-Month-Old Grandson Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 58-year-old woman lost her life and her 13-month-old grandson was injured in a tragic lift-related accident at an apartment complex in Hyderabad's Khairatabad area, fire officials said.

body.html:
A 58-year-old woman lost her life and her 13-month-old grandson was injured in a tragic lift-related accident at an apartment complex in Hyderabad's Khairatabad area, fire officials said.

The incident occurred at Bhavana Apartments in Anand Nagar Colony, following which the Amberpet Fire and Rescue Team rushed to the spot and carried out rescue operations.

According to preliminary findings, the woman, identified as Radha, was on the fifth floor when she allegedly opened the lift door before the elevator had arrived.

The door reportedly opened unexpectedly, causing her to fall through the lift shaft to the first floor. She suffered fatal injuries and was declared dead at the scene.

Her 13-month-old grandson, Jeol, who was with her at the time, sustained injuries and was shifted to a hospital for treatment.

Fire and rescue personnel conducted the operation under the supervision of senior officials.

Authorities have launched an investigation to ascertain the exact circumstances that led to the accident and to determine how the lift door opened before the elevator reached the floor.

#Hyderabad #LiftAccident #Khairatabad #BreakingNews

articles.title: Rushing an Accident Victim, They Met the Same Fate: 5 Killed After Car Crashes Into Dumper
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident on the Morbi-Halvad Highway claimed the lives of five young men and left two others critically injured on Saturday night (5 June 2026) after their car crashed into a dumper near Charadwa village.

body.html:
A tragic road accident on the Morbi-Halvad Highway claimed the lives of five young men and left two others critically injured on Saturday night (5 June 2026) after their car crashed into a dumper near Charadwa village.

According to police and local sources, the accident occurred at around 9.30 pm when the car carrying seven people was travelling at high speed towards a hospital. The group was taking an injured man, who had earlier met with a motorcycle accident near Mansar village in Halvad taluka, for emergency treatment.

Initial investigations suggest that a heavy dumper suddenly entered the highway after exiting a nearby factory. Despite the driver's attempt to apply the brakes, the car rammed into the dumper with tremendous force.

The impact was devastating, completely crushing the front portion of the vehicle and trapping it beneath the dumper. Several occupants were trapped inside the mangled wreckage.

The victims were residents of Ranchhodgarh village and had rushed to help the injured motorcyclist before the fatal collision.

The deceased have been identified as Premji Dadheya, a taluka panchayat member of the Aam Aadmi Party, Suresh Sihora (47), Viram Dadheya (28), Paresh Dadheya (24), and Bharat Dadheya (39).

Three victims died on the spot due to severe injuries, while two others succumbed during treatment at a hospital.

The two survivors, Prakash Dadheya and Dilip Dadheya, sustained serious injuries and remain in critical condition. They are undergoing treatment at hospitals in Morbi and Rajkot.

Emergency response teams and local volunteers worked together to rescue the trapped passengers before ambulances shifted the injured to nearby hospitals.

After receiving information about the accident, police officials from Halvad taluka reached the spot and launched an investigation. The bodies of the deceased have been sent for post-mortem examinations, while investigators are collecting evidence to determine the exact circumstances that led to the collision.

Preliminary findings indicate that the dumper was crossing the highway after exiting a factory when the accident occurred.

#MorbiAccident #GujaratNews #RoadAccident #Halvad #BreakingNews
